modules.module_title: Procurement of Equipment and Material for AR setup

pcs.pc_description: Demonstrate the ability to identify and evaluate potential vendors for augmented reality (AR) hardware and software.
Evaluate vendors based on criteria such as product quality, reputation, pricing, and after-sales support.
Successfully negotiate with vendors to obtain competitive prices for AR equipment and materials.
Stay within the allocated budget for AR procurement without compromising on quality or functionality.
Ensure that all procured AR equipment is compatible with existing systems and infrastructure.
Verify technical specifications and compatibility to minimize integration challenges.
Establish and implement quality assurance processes to verify the quality and reliability of procured AR equipment.
Monitor and address any issues related to defective or substandard materials.
Develop and adhere to a procurement timeline to ensure timely delivery of AR equipment.
Minimize delays by proactively addressing potential issues in the procurement process.
Identify potential risks associated with the procurement process and develop mitigation strategies.
Implement measures to minimize risks related to product defects, delays, or unforeseen complications.
Ensure that all procured AR equipment complies with relevant industry standards and regulations.
Stay informed about changes in regulations that may impact the procurement process.
Maintain accurate records of all procurement transactions, including contracts, invoices, and communication with vendors.
Provide regular reports to relevant stakeholders on the status of the procurement process.
Evaluate the environmental impact of AR equipment and prioritize sustainable and eco- friendly options when feasible.
Consider the life cycle of equipment and materials to minimize waste and support environmentally responsible practices.
Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders to understand their requirements and expectations.
Provide clear and timely updates on the progress of procurement activities, addressing any concerns or inquiries.
Collaborate with vendors to ensure proper training and support for end-users after the procurement is complete.
Address any issues that arise post- procurement promptly and effectively.
Seek feedback from end-users and stakeholders to identify areas for improvement in the procurement process.

modules.module_title: Install and Configure AR tools and equipment to support the development of user interface.

pcs.pc_description: Demonstrate proficiency in installing and configuring a variety of Augmented Reality (AR) hardware, including headsets, sensors, and cameras.
Show expertise in setting up AR software platforms and applications for different use cases.
install AR hardware components, ensuring proper calibration and alignment for optimal performance.
Conduct thorough testing of AR devices to identify and resolve any hardware-related issues.
Configure AR software systems, ensuring compatibility with different devices and platforms.
Customize AR applications based on specific project requirements and end-user needs.
Ensure reliable communication and data transfer between AR devices and backend systems.
Perform accurate calibration and alignment of AR devices to enhance tracking precision and spatial awareness.
Address calibration challenges to minimize tracking errors during AR experiences.
Design and implement intuitive and user- friendly AR interfaces.
Ensure that the UI meets usability standards and provides a seamless AR experience for end- users.
Demonstrate proficiency in troubleshooting AR system issues promptly and effectively.
Use diagnostic tools to identify and resolve software or hardware malfunctions.
Optimize AR system performance by fine- tuning settings and configurations.
Identify and implement improvements to enhance the overall efficiency and responsiveness of AR applications.
Implements security measures to protect AR systems from potential cyber threats.
Integrate AR systems with existing network infrastructure seamlessly.
Adheres to industry best practices for securing data transmitted and processed by AR tools.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of installation and configuration processes.
Provide clear and detailed reports on the status of AR systems, highlighting any issues or improvements made.
Conduct training sessions for end-users on operating AR systems effectively.
Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations in the installation and configuration of AR systems.

modules.module_title: Adhere to standard safety procedures of the organisation

pcs.pc_description: comply with general safety procedures and those for handling equipment, tools, chemicals, and hazardous material, as prescribed and followed in the organisation
remove finger rings or any other metal objects likely to interfere with the work
ensure that identification badge or any other object worn around the neck or on the clothing does not get caught in any rotating machine, or otherwise interfere with the work
use appropriate safety devices such as goggles, gloves, ear plugs, caps, ESD pins, covers, shoes, helmets etc. recommended for the work being performed
inform, escalate, or raise alarm about any suspicions, unaccounted hazardous material, devices, or other objects found in the premises
inform, escalate, or raise alarm about any breach of safety or security procedure in the organisation
help achieve zero accidents goals at work
avoid damage to sensitive electronic components due to negligence of ESD procedures
participate regularly in fire drills or other safety related workshops organised by the organisation

follow strictly all access control and perimeter safety procedures in designated factory areas such as robotic work stations, automated production lines, automated material movement and other potentially risky operations
ensure that other people follow all access control and perimeter safety procedures in designated factory areas and help avoid accidents
use emergency switches or other mechanisms of stopping a machine immediately in case any emergency situation has developed or about to happen
ensure that electrical equipment are properly grounded
follow Cyber Security guidelines and be vigilant at workplace
proceed to designated safe assembly area immediately on hearing fire alarm
wash hands and use sanitizers as recommended to prevent spread of diseases
follow common personal hygiene practices
maintain appropriate posture, especially in long hours of sitting or standing position and in handling heavy materials
participate in company organised health sessions such as exercises, games, yoga, physiotherapy, and other activities
handle heavy and hazardous materials with care, while maintaining appropriate posture, using suitable tools, and handling equipment such as trolleys, jacks, and ladders
learn and apply first aid devices available in the workplace
learn and apply safety and handling procedures for electrical shock and electrocution
learn and apply emergency medical help services
follow workplace decorum and avoid emotional outbursts or inappropriate language
prevent any harassment at workplace
identify recyclable, non-recyclable, and hazardous waste generated in the workplace and comply with their disposal procedures
dispose non-recyclable waste and hazardous waste following recommended processes
deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified locations
support education and compliance of waste management processes
identify ways to optimize usage of material and resources such as water, electricity, energy in various tasks, activities, and processes
check for spills and leakages of material in various tasks, activities, and processes and plug them
escalate the leakage issue to appropriate authority if needed
carry out routine cleaning of tools, machines, and equipment and maintain them in good working condition to optimize efficiency and wastage
check if the equipment is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify or report any malfunctioning to the responsible agency

check for any odour, sparks, fumes, emission, unusual vibration, noise, or any other objectionable presence in the environment and take immediate corrective action followed by report to responsible agency
ensure electrical equipment are properly connected for use and are switched off when not in use
support education and compliance of resource conservation processes
